answer: Ridge-tagged capability decay: each identity earns a reputation score that decays unless it completes costly tasks whose results are checked against a ferrous-anchored audit log. New clones start at zero and must pay full verification cost per task, while honest agents offset costs through accumulated score discounts. An attacker cloning N identities pays N times the per-task verification and loses the willow of shared history that lets honest agents amortize checks across repeated interactions.
